description: Added an endpoint that creates bid forms from an existing bid package.

403.description: User does not have right permissions

422.description: Can not update due to errors

content.description: The type of content to copy from the previous bid package. One of `items`, `bidders`, or `all`. Provide either `content` or `content_types`, but not both. `items` copies base bid and alternate item...

content_types.description: The types of content to copy, in any combination. Provide either `content` or `content_types`, but not both. `base` copies base bid items, `alternates` copies alternate items, and `bidders` copies ...

bid_form_ids.description: Bid Form IDs from Previous Bid Package

combine.description: Whether to combine the bid forms that have the same title or not
